firm_data.firm_description: Russo PLLC is a boutique legal firm offering innovative solutions for global business needs. They provide strategic guidance and legal representation for domestic and international clients.
notable_facts: Offers custom teams hand-picked to meet specific client needs.
Engages in strategic planning with an elite network of professionals from various fields.
Committed to environmental sustainability and energy conservation.
technology_signals: Uses bamboo, reusable, scannable business cards in partnership with V1CE for sustainable networking.
